name: refas
description: Vision-first, evidence-bound reference image to 3D reconstruction with multiview QA.

interface.longDescription: A vision-first reconstruction skill and runtime that lets an agent observe references, build traceable 3D assets, compare actual multiview renders, and preserve observation/inference provenance.
defaultPrompt: Use RefAs to reconstruct this reference as a traceable 3D asset with multiview QA.
Use RefAs to rebuild this reference with evidence-bound geometry and explicit observation/inference separation.
